scope: Targeted development experiment on all three historical PPO actors; no replacement of earlier evidence or reserved evaluation.
hypotheses: Categorical residual steps at high zero-delay authority increase executed steering activity; isolate smoothing then a local nominal actuator-rate projection.
The historical PPO was trained under predictive admission but evaluated under latency gain. Retrain within the exact new deployed wrapper.
Command increments in the legacy reward are not the reported actuator-rate RMS. Compare legacy reward against an executed-rate reward with otherwise identical training.

controller.rate_budget: one-tick nominal absolute actuator rate <= min(0.35,1.02*same-state LQR predicted absolute rate); project along baseline-to-smoothed-candidate segment
controller.limits: Local nominal projection is not a global RMS or robust safety guarantee. Preserve current-state LQR, immediate invalid/stale revocation, original physical plant and sensor noise.

training.initialization: Corresponding historical finetune endpoint. Lossless zero-column bridge for actor AND critic on formerly zero observation channel14; channel14 now available filtered residual. Other parameters, Adam and reward statistics preserved. Reset only changed first-layer bias/column Adam slots. Fresh matched RNG/environment.
training.credit: Only submitted requests receive actor credit; fixed-tick GAE and critic remain unchanged.
training.physical_reward: Negative (ey/.5)^2 + .2*(heading/.1)^2 + .2*(executed actuator rate/.35)^2 + .005*(command/.5)^2; additional -10 on failure.
training.optimizer: lr1e-4, entropy0, gamma.99, lambda.95, nsteps250, 4env, batch200, 5epochs, clip.1, targetKL.01. No extension, intermediate-checkpoint selection, or mixed-seed winner.
training.distribution: Original three speeds, two development paths, both mirrors; nominal zero-service/tire/delay20/delay100. poll10 is an additional development diagnostic, not a training case.

development.comparability: All methods share physical sensing, path, actuator, noise ID and episode length. Nominal zero-service is a synchronous simulation case, not measured real-worker latency. All models use the causal bridge; no future completion time enters observations.

acceptance.requirements: >=1% aggregate tracking gain against every comparator; positive per-pair gain against student; all episodes survive; exact100ms LQR fallback; nominal per-pair tracking <=1.02LQR; heading and rate <=1.05LQR. User20% aspirational target reported separately against all four comparators. No all-scenario-best claim from aggregate pass.

resume: Atomic full training state every10k and each complete episode with hashes. Final100k endpoints only. Single runner verifies frozen inputs and resumes remaining steps; publish milestones to existing branch.
stop: Report both training arms and all wrappers even when requirements fail. No automatic new tuning, reserved tests, deployment or physical readiness claims.
